comparison.objective: Hold a carton steady while inserting a divider into mounting slots.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual carton stabilization, slot alignment, compliant sheet insertion, and depth control.
comparison.success_condition: Divider must seat within 2 mm of target depth; setup and scoring fields are otherwise explicitly missing.
comparison.reason: Despite shared bimanual stabilization and alignment, divider insertion tests seating a compliant planar part, not impact-induced fracture and recovery of independently simulated tangs.
